items.title: ThriftShoewear Commerce Platform
items.label: Private Commerce Stack
items.description: Full e-commerce stack with private storefront and backend repos plus a public admin dashboard for products, orders, users, coupons, reviews, wishlist, cart, payments, and shipments.

items.outcome: A private full-stack commerce system with customer storefront, admin operations, and a hardened Express API.

WhatsApp ordering flow for direct customer communication
